sentences.text: This application coming on for admission this day,

the   following:
 ORDER
Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is third application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant/accused,
relating to FIR/Crime No.293/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Agar Malwa,
District Agar (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 307, 323 342, 498A, 201,
326B/34 of IPC.
The first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn.
The Second bail application was dismissed on merit.
2. Prosecution story in brief, is that marriage of the victim/injured was solemnized with the accused Krishnapal Singh in the year 2020.
After the marriage, the present applicant being mother-in-law and accused Jagdish and Krishnapal being father-in-law and husband, respectively of the deceased used to demand a vehicle as dowry.

Due to demand of dowry, they used to assault the Smt. Sangeeta vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90285054/
1 victim/injured.

sentences.text: Father of the victim was not in the position to fulfill the demand.
Therefore, the applicant and co-accused person once tried to burn the victim by pouring kerosene, but she fled away from the house and saved herself.
Thereafter, she called her father and went to her parental home and did not report the matter to the Police considering that the matter will get sort out in a few days.
On 09.05.2023, at around 09:00 AM, when she was cooking, she mistakenly dropped oil and the accused persons started abusing her.
The present applicant with intent to kill the victim, lit Saree of victim on fire by matchstick.
The body of the victim had started to burn because of fire.
Then her husband and present applicant closed the door and left the home.
The victim then went and sat in the bucket of water, which stopped the fire.
She received burn injuries on her leg and thigh.
Thereafter, the victim called her maternal uncle by phone.
Her maternal uncle and other relative came there, she got unconscious and was taken to hospital in Agar and thereafter to Ujjain.

She was admitted for treatment from 10.05.2023 - 15.05.2023.
3 .
Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and she has falsely been implicated in the case.
The applicant is mother-in-law of the complainant Sonabai.

After the dismissal of the second bail application,complainant Sonabai (PW 1), father of the complainant namely Guman Singh, (PW2) and Doctor Vishal Dubey (PW 3) have been examined before the Trial Court and they have completely turned hostile and have not supported the prosecution case.
The applicant is in custody since 6/7/2023.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
4 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State has opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the records, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that the present applicant is entitled for grant of bail.
6.

It is directed that applicant- Smt. Sangeeta shall be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court, for her appearance before the concerned Court regularly on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.

It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
8. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed off.
Certified copy, as per Rules.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE Pramod Smt. Sangeeta vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90285054/
